summary: Responder chain, key equivalents, menus, gesture recognizers (tap, pan, long press, pinch, rotation), typed drag and drop, dock badge and an AT-SPI accessibility bridge exist. Tracking-area enter, exit and move events and a cursor stack exist as pure models but are not yet delivered to apps. Scroll wheel, the Dock menu, custom Dock tiles and Touch Bar are missing.

features.apple: NSEvent, NSResponder, key events, tracking areas, trackpad touches
features.note: responder chain, key combos and focus loop exist; tracking.rs models tracking-area enter, exit and move with overlapping areas, not yet fed by the app input path; no wheel or nextKeyView yet (docs/bifrost-ui.md ~line 870)

menu bar, validation, key equivalents, status items and Dock badge (Ctx::set_badge) exist; cursor.rs models the cursor stack (push, pop, set, hide counting, shape names) but no SDK call or compositor cursor request uses it yet; no custom Dock tile content or Dock menu

features.apple: NSGestureRecognizer and subclasses (click, pan, magnification, rotation, press)
features.note: recognizer state machines exist as pure models: tap, pan, long press, Magnify (pinch) and Rotate (two-finger rotation); the compositor does not yet send two-finger trackpad touches to apps
typed drag and drop between apps (docs/bifrost-ui.md section 508); the view kit itself has no drag and drop (line ~873), so views need app glue
AT-SPI2 bridge with label/title/help, caret and selection, announcements; the Node is flat so nesting is reported only by ax_tree()

gaps: Tracking-area events delivered to views (model in springboard/ui/src/tracking.rs, no app path yet)
Cursor API for apps: the stack model exists (springboard/ui/src/cursor.rs), no SDK call or compositor cursor request yet
Dock tile custom content and Dock menu
Trackpad magnify and rotate from the compositor to apps (recognizers exist in springboard/ui/src/gesture.rs)
Drag and drop inside the retained view kit
